manualChecks.label: Cloudflare Access and MFA protect /admin
manualChecks.reason: The Access application and identity-provider policy are account-level controls that this repository cannot prove with the R2-scoped audit token.

manualChecks.label: WAF rate limits and Worker/R2/D1 spend notifications are active
manualChecks.reason: Rule expressions, notification destinations, and billing thresholds require a separate privileged account review and must not be inferred from Worker source.

manualChecks.label: No second Git-triggered production deployment path is enabled
manualChecks.reason: Cloudflare dashboard build integrations are external state and are intentionally reported as manual-only rather than guessed from GitHub workflow files.

manualChecks.label: The current main-branch review and required-check policy matches the operator's release policy
manualChecks.reason: The automated check proves the minimum history-protection rules only; whether pull requests or named checks must be mandatory is a product-operations decision.
